message: Which backend should the cache layer use?

oneOf.title: Redis
oneOf.description: External Redis server. Shared across processes/machines, survives restarts, supports TTL and eviction natively. Adds a service dependency and network hop.

oneOf.title: In-memory (process-local)
oneOf.description: A dict/LRU inside the process. Fastest and zero dependencies, but not shared between workers and lost on restart.

oneOf.title: Disk / SQLite
oneOf.description: Local file-backed cache. Survives restarts and handles large values, shared across processes on one host, but slower than memory and not shared across machines.

oneOf.title: Memcached
oneOf.description: External Memcached server. Simple, fast, shared key-value cache with LRU eviction; no persistence and no rich data types.
